configuration.instructions:
*** Operational Instructions ***
1. Notify when "NewlyStaleCount" is above 0 in table sig_stale_items.
2.Alert: recommend email the owner about stale items in "OwnerUpn" with "ItemList". Never recommend deletion.
*** Semantic Instructions ***
1. Each row is one workspace and owner, identified by "WorkspaceId" and "OwnerUpn".
2. "NewlyStaleCount" is the number of items that passed 90 days without use since the previous run.
3. "OldestDaysInactive" is the longest inactivity in days among those items.

00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.description: Emails the owner the list of unused items with a 30-day notice to reply 'keep'.

47abfc17-7099-45b7-8152-3f7860dbadd7.Name: Notify Workspace Owner Newly Stale Items
47abfc17-7099-45b7-8152-3f7860dbadd7.Description: Notify the workspace owner when any items have newly become stale since the previous run, based on NewlyStaleCount in sig_stale_items, and email them a list of those stale items without recommending deletion.

ClassExpression.Description: Notify the workspace owner when any items have newly become stale since the previous run, based on NewlyStaleCount in sig_stale_items, and email them a list of those stale items without recommending deletion.

ChartTemplate.TemplateEnvelope:
<chart_template rule_id="47abfc17-7099-45b7-8152-3f7860dbadd7" value_field="NewlyStaleCount" trigger_type="AttributeTrigger"><query><![CDATA[declare query_parameters(instanceId:string, startTime:datetime, endTime:datetime);
let WorkspaceOwnerStaleItems =
    ['sig_stale_items']
    | extend Id = strcat(['WorkspaceId'], "||", ['OwnerUpn'])
    | where Id == instanceId
    | where ['SnapshotUtc'] between (startTime .. endTime)
    | project
        Timestamp = ['SnapshotUtc'],
        NewlyStaleCount = ['NewlyStaleCount'];
WorkspaceOwnerStaleItems
| project Timestamp, Value = NewlyStaleCount]]></query></chart_template>
